Use the single supplied local grid as the only reference. The top row repeats this NPC's selected guarded OPEN phase; the bottom row repeats its selected guarded HALF phase. Preserve the same character, crop, hair, asymmetric guarded brows, eye placement, compact olive/amber iris-and-pupil shapes, dark eye shadows, subdued palette, and pixel-art clusters.

Output exactly a 2x2 atlas of complete 64x35 upper-face crops, with no margins, gutters, or labels: top-left LEFT OPEN, top-right RIGHT OPEN, bottom-left LEFT HALF, bottom-right RIGHT HALF.

Move only the compact iris and dark pupil clusters horizontally by about one native pixel. For LEFT, both eyes look slightly toward the canvas left edge. For RIGHT, both eyes look slightly toward the canvas right edge. Both eyes must track together with natural convergence; neither may remain centered. Keep the irises and pupils small, olive/amber, and darkly shaded, with only tiny muted warm glints.

Keep the source's narrow eye openings and guarded upper-lid contours. Keep the eye interiors dark brown and olive. Do not add any white or cream sclera bands, pale patches, or brighter broad areas; do not enlarge or round the eyes. The HALF row keeps the source half-closed aperture, with upper lids covering most of the irises and only a narrow slit visible. Keep lower lids, brows, hair, and cheeks fixed, including original locked cheek pixels at rows 29-30. Crisp native stepped pixels only; no smoothing or new facial detail.
